author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Golden bread boats fresh from the oven, filled with a rich and savory mixture of meat and potatoes 🌶️🍞 In this video, we prepare rustic bread boats the traditional way — soft homemade dough shaped and baked with a hearty filling inside.

The crust turns beautifully golden and slightly crispy, while the filling stays warm, juicy, and full of comforting flavor. The combination of tender potatoes, seasoned meat, and fresh bread makes every bite deeply satisfying.

This is true homemade village cooking — simple ingredients, generous portions, and recipes made to bring people together. A cozy, filling dish perfect for sharing around the table.
title: Golden Bread Boats with Savory Filling – Meat and Potato Bread Boats 🌶
